timeline.summary: Head of Product Design at Instinct, leading a team of four Senior Product Designers. I set the design strategy across the veterinary product line and am building Instinct's internal design system, so the team ships one coherent product rather than a set of separate screens.
highlights: Manage a team of four Senior Product Designers
Lead design strategy across Instinct's veterinary products
Building Instinct's internal design system, Axon

timeline.summary: Lead designer on Instinct's veterinary software, working close to the live product. Alongside the day-to-day product work I manage Axon, the internal design system, and a code-prototyping workflow that keeps iteration fast, so craft and delivery don't trade off against each other.
highlights: Lead designer on Instinct EMR, a practice information management system for veterinary clinics
Lead designer on Standards and Plumbs, the clinical guidance product for veterinarians
Manage Axon, the design system that underpins product UI
Built a code-prototyping workflow that compressed iteration from weeks to hours
Focus: cut the admin burden by meeting vets in their real workflow

timeline.summary: Promoted to manage craft and people at once: a team of designers, a design system serving thousands of products, and hands-on leadership on AI work the firm pitched to Fortune 500 clients. Built a suite of custom GPTs that automated the busywork (release notes, copy, tasks, reviews) so managers and designers could spend their time on judgment, not formatting.
highlights: Managed and mentored a team of three designers while owning craft standards across product lines
Ran the design system that serviced 3,000+ products globally
Led GenAI workflow tooling that gave managers back up to 30 percent of their week
Lead designer on SDLC Canvas, taking the firm's flagship AI product from POC to Fortune 500 pitches

timeline.summary: Came into a Sketch, Abstract and InVision stack that was burning hours on versioning fights and blocking remote collaboration. Built the business case, piloted Figma, rebuilt 30+ system components natively, wrote 100+ pages of docs, and ran months of office hours until the whole department was on one tool. That cut about 3.5 hours a week of lost-work thrash to near zero and retired three redundant licenses.
highlights: Led the org-wide Figma migration and upskilled 120+ designers with curriculum, docs and office hours
Audited and rebuilt the design system in Figma: atomic components, variants, real interaction states
Led a UX pattern library for 50+ product teams, with 86+ fewer one-off requests and 12 patterns shipped to the system site
Cut prototype cycles from weeks to days and unblocked concurrent, conflict-free collaboration

timeline.summary: Agency pace, marketing pressure, dozens of concurrent home-service brands. Instead of redrawing the same site structure every time, I built a modular Figma block system with client theming so designers could ship faster without tanking craft. Some smaller projects dropped from a full day to about 30 minutes.
highlights: Designed and shipped custom sites for 80+ home-service companies
Led the Rapid Page Template Builder, with about 80 percent less time on repeat layout work
Raised visual quality on templated builds without slowing delivery

timeline.summary: Years of owning the whole job: discovery, brand, web, product UI and handoff, first as a freelancer and then as a formalized creative studio. I learned how to sell work, keep clients and ship without a team to hide behind. The foundation under everything that came after.
highlights: Delivered 40+ client projects across branding, web and product design
Grew a self-taught Mac tutorial channel to 30k+ subscribers and multi-million views
Turned one-off gigs into retainers and formalized the practice into a creative studio

principles.title: Core principles
principles.headline: Design from the Ask to the Experience
principles.intro: Design today goes beyond UX. It touches everything from advocacy and alignment to accessibility and authentic experiences. In a world where mockups can be automated, it's leadership, clarity and heart that set products apart.
principles.lead: Here are the traits I bring to every project and every team:

traits.title: Adaptability
traits.text: I listen deeply, adjust quickly, and thrive within shifting constraints.

traits.title: Boldness
traits.text: I challenge assumptions, embrace new ideas, and push teams toward excellence.

traits.title: Inclusivity
traits.text: I design with empathy, ensuring experiences are accessible and welcoming to all.

traits.title: Articulation
traits.text: I bring clarity to collaboration, helping teams move forward with shared understanding.

traits.title: Curiosity
traits.text: I explore relentlessly, always seeking better ways to solve problems and create value.

traits.title: Resilience
traits.text: I navigate ambiguity, learn from setbacks, and persist toward meaningful outcomes.
